title.zh: 幼儿发展中心（豁免）命令 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Early Childhood Development Centres (Exemption) Order 2018.
2. The operator of an early childhood development centre specified in the Schedule is exempt from section 6(1) of the Act in relation to that centre.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
Early childhood development centres
1. EIS International Pre‑School
2. EtonHouse International Pre‑School
3. Ganenu
4. Japanese Kindergarten
5. Konohana Kindergarten
6. Korean Church Kindergarten
7. Rain Trees International Kindergarten
8. Rosemount Kindergarten
9. Waldorf Steiner Early Years Centre
